description: This file implements infrastructure for writing SHA1-summed files, including functions for verifying, flushing, finalizing, and discarding hash files, as well as handling checksum validation and progress reporting.

methods.name: void verify_buffer_or_die(struct hashfile * f,const void * buf,unsigned int count)
methods.description: Verifies the buffer contents against the check buffer read from the hash file; terminates execution on error.

methods.name: void flush(struct hashfile * f,const void * buf,unsigned int count)
methods.description: Writes buffer contents to the file, verifying correctness if check_fd is open.

methods.name: void hashflush(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Flushes the current buffer, updating the hash context.

methods.name: void free_hashfile(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a hashfile structure.

methods.name: int finalize_hashfile(struct hashfile * f,unsigned char * result,enum fsync_component component,unsigned int flags)
methods.description: Finalizes the hash calculation, writes the hash if required, fsyncs, closes files, and frees resources.

methods.name: void discard_hashfile(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Closes associated file descriptors and frees the hashfile structure.

methods.name: void hashwrite(struct hashfile * f,const void * buf,unsigned int count)
methods.description: Writes data to the hashfile, updating hash and checksum as needed.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd_check(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,const char * name)
methods.description: Creates a hashfile structure for checking a file against a dev null sink.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd_internal(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,int fd,const char * name,struct progress * tp,size_t buffer_len)
methods.description: Internal function to create a hashfile structure for hashing given a file descriptor.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,int fd,const char * name)
methods.description: Creates a hashfile structure for hashing data from a file descriptor, with default buffer size.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd_throughput(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,int fd,const char * name,struct progress * tp)
methods.description: Creates a hashfile for hashing with progress reporting, using a smaller buffer.

methods.name: void hashfile_checkpoint_init(struct hashfile * f,struct hashfile_checkpoint * checkpoint)
methods.description: Initializes a checkpoint structure for a hashfile.

methods.name: void hashfile_checkpoint(struct hashfile * f,struct hashfile_checkpoint * checkpoint)
methods.description: Creates a checkpoint for a hashfile, saving current state.

methods.name: int hashfile_truncate(struct hashfile * f,struct hashfile_checkpoint * checkpoint)
methods.description: Truncates a hashfile to a checkpoint’s offset, restoring hash state.

methods.name: uint32_t crc32_end(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Finalizes CRC32 checksum calculation and returns the result.

methods.name: int hashfile_checksum_valid(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,const unsigned char * data,size_t total_len)
methods.description: Validates the checksum of the given data against the hash algorithm.
